intro_paragraphs: Most HVAC failures ignore business hours. Frost Fire provides after-hours HVAC repair for nights, weekends, and holidays across the Triangle — with the same fair rates on Sundays that we charge on Tuesday.

Call us for no-cool AC emergencies, heat pump failures, furnace outages, and commercial refrigeration issues that cannot wait until morning. We will tell you honestly whether it is a true emergency dispatch or a first-thing morning slot.
Searching after hours hvac repair near me or night time ac repair? Call (919) 230-4439.

faqs.q: Do you charge more after hours?
faqs.a: We do not add a Sunday surcharge. Call for current after-hours availability and any applicable emergency dispatch details.
If temperatures are unsafe, water is leaking, or food inventory is at risk, call now. Otherwise we can often book first-thing morning.

faqs.q: Do you cover commercial after hours?
faqs.a: Yes — including RTUs and walk-in coolers/freezers.
